question_model_family.question: What is the stable base model family name, without version, size, or release information?

question_model_variant.question: What is the model variant name? Use the YAML model_name. Lowercase it and replace spaces and hyphens by underscores.

question_model_parameters.question: How many parameters does this specific model variant have?

question_model_architectures.question: What are the architecture(s) used for this model? Return only a JSON array of architecture names.

question_architecture_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of {item} among the MachineLearningArchitecture classes? Return only an existing ontology class local name.

question_architecture_parameters.question: For the {item} architecture, extract only its total number of parameters as an integer. If unknown, return null.

question_architecture_datasets.question: Which datasets were used to train the {item} architecture? Return only dataset names.

question_architecture_hyperparameters.question: What hyperparameters are reported for training the {item} architecture? Return only a JSON array of hyperparameter names.

question_hyperparameter_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of the hyperparameter {item}? Return only an existing ontology class local name.

question_hyperparameter_value.question: What is the value of the hyperparameter {item}?

question_architecture_components.question: What are the named sub-components of the {item} architecture? Return only a JSON array of component architecture names, or an empty array.

question_architecture_backbone.question: What backbone architecture is used by {item}? Return only the architecture name, or null.

question_architecture_head.question: What prediction head or output head architecture is used by {item}? Return only the architecture name, or null.

question_architecture_layer_count.question: How many layers does the {item} architecture or configuration have? Return an integer or null.

question_architecture_hidden_dimension.question: What hidden dimension, embedding dimension, or feature dimension is reported for {item}? Return an integer or null.

question_all_training_runs.question: What training runs or training processes are described for this model family? Return a JSON array of stable snake_case identifiers. Include pretraining runs, fine-tuning runs, active learning runs, scratch training runs, and generic training runs when explicitly mentioned.

question_training_run_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of the training run {item}? Return only one existing ontology class local name such as PretrainingRun, MachineLearningTrainingRun, MachineLearningFinetuningRun, or MachineLearningActiveLearningRun.

question_training_run_architectures.question: Which architectures are associated with the training run {item}? Return only architecture names.

question_training_run_datasets.question: Which datasets are used by the training run {item}? Return only dataset names.

question_training_run_optimizer.question: Which optimizer is used by the training run {item}? Return null if not specified.

question_training_run_loss_function.question: Which loss function is used by the training run {item}? Return null if not specified.

question_training_run_description.question: Provide a short description of the training run {item}.

question_training_run_objective_function.question: Which objective function is used by the training run {item}? Return null if not specified.

question_training_run_sampling_method.question: Which sampling method is used by the training run {item}, such as active learning sampling, batch selection, random sampling, curriculum sampling, or dataset sampling? Return null if not specified.

question_training_run_uses_batched_selec.question: Does the active learning or sampling process in training run {item} use batched selection? Return true, false, or null.

question_training_run_initialized_from.question: Is the training run {item} initialized from a previous checkpoint, pretrained model, or model materialization? Return the source model or checkpoint name, or null.

question_training_run_teacher_model.question: If {item} is a distillation run, what teacher model is used? Return the model/checkpoint name or null.

question_training_run_student_model.question: If {item} is a distillation run, what student model is trained? Return the model/checkpoint name or null.

question_training_run_outputs.question: What model checkpoints or materialized models are produced by training run {item}? Return only a JSON array of names.

question_all_datasets.question: Which datasets are mentioned as training, validation, test, pretraining, fine-tuning, benchmark, or derived datasets? Return a JSON array of stable dataset names.

question_dataset_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of dataset {item}? Return only one existing class local name such as Dataset, TrainingDataset, LabeledDataset, or DatasetSplit.

question_dataset_samples.question: How many samples, structures, configurations, crystals, molecules, or materials are reported for dataset {item}? Return an integer or null.

question_dataset_representation.question: What data representation is used for dataset {item}, such as crystal graph, atomic structure, molecule graph, composition, trajectory, or point cloud? Return a short name or null.

question_dataset_labelling_method.question: How are labels or targets obtained for dataset {item}, such as DFT, relaxation, molecular dynamics, experimental measurement, or another method? Return a short name or null.

question_dataset_input_features.question: What input attributes or features are used from dataset {item}? Return only a JSON array of feature names.

question_dataset_target_features.question: What target attributes or labels are predicted from dataset {item}? Return only a JSON array of target names.

question_dataset_derived_from.question: Is dataset {item} derived from another dataset? Return the source dataset name, or null.

question_all_evaluation_runs.question: Which model evaluation runs, benchmark evaluations, leaderboard submissions, validation experiments, or test evaluations are described for this model? Return a JSON array of stable snake_case identifiers. For Matbench Discovery, use YAML fields train_task, test_task, targets, and especially metrics as the authoritative source before the PDF. Include one evaluation run per official Matbench Discovery task actually present in YAML metrics.

question_evaluation_run_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of evaluation run {item}? Return only MachineLearningEvaluationRun.

question_evaluation_run_model_variant.question: Which model variant is evaluated by evaluation run {item}? Return the model variant name, preferably the YAML model_name or model_key, or null if not specified.

question_evaluation_run_benchmark_releas.question: Which benchmark suite or benchmark release is used by evaluation run {item}? For YAML metrics from matbench-discovery.materialsproject.org, return matbench_discovery_benchmark_release. For a named paper benchmark outside Matbench Discovery, return that benchmark release name or null.

question_evaluation_run_task.question: Which official Matbench Discovery task is evaluated by evaluation run {item}? Return exactly one of: thermodynamic_stability_classification_task, convex_hull_distance_regression_task, phonon_thermal_conductivity_contribution_task, relaxed_structure_matching_rmsd_task. Map YAML metrics.discovery classification metrics such as F1, Precision, Recall, Accuracy, TPR, FPR, TNR, FNR, TP, FP, TN, FN, or DAF to thermodynamic_stability_classification_task; map YAML metrics.discovery regression metrics MAE, RMSE, or R2 for convex hull distance to convex_hull_distance_regression_task; map YAML metrics.phonons to phonon_thermal_conductivity_contribution_task; map YAML metrics.geo_opt RMSD/StructureMatcher metrics to relaxed_structure_matching_rmsd_task.

question_evaluation_run_dataset.question: Which dataset is used for evaluation run {item}? Return the dataset name or null.

question_evaluation_run_folds.question: Which folds or dataset splits are used in evaluation run {item}? Return a JSON array of stable names such as train_split, validation_split, test_split, fold_0, or empty array if folds are not specified.

question_evaluation_run_metric_results.question: What metric results are reported for evaluation run {item}? Return a JSON array of stable snake_case metric result identifiers from YAML metrics when available. Preserve the Matbench Discovery metric family and split in the identifier, for example discovery_full_test_set_f1, discovery_full_test_set_mae, phonons_kappa_103_kappa_srme, geo_opt_symprec_1e_5_rmsd. Include paper-only metrics only when no YAML metric exists.

question_all_benchmark_releases.question: Which benchmark suites or benchmark releases are mentioned for evaluation? If YAML metrics are from Matbench Discovery, include matbench_discovery_benchmark_release. Also include paper-specific benchmark releases only when explicitly distinct from Matbench Discovery.

question_benchmark_release_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of benchmark release {item}? Return only BenchmarkRelease.

question_benchmark_release_tasks.question: Which official Matbench Discovery tasks belong to benchmark release {item}? Return only task identifiers from this controlled list: thermodynamic_stability_classification_task, convex_hull_distance_regression_task, phonon_thermal_conductivity_contribution_task, relaxed_structure_matching_rmsd_task.

question_all_tasks.question: Which of the four official Matbench Discovery tasks are mentioned? Return only a JSON array containing identifiers from this controlled list: thermodynamic_stability_classification_task, convex_hull_distance_regression_task, phonon_thermal_conductivity_contribution_task, relaxed_structure_matching_rmsd_task. Map stable/unstable material classification and thermodynamic stability classification to thermodynamic_stability_classification_task; map MAE/RMSE/R2 of predicted vs DFT convex hull distance to convex_hull_distance_regression_task; map normalized phonon mode thermal conductivity contribution metrics to phonon_thermal_conductivity_contribution_task; map normalized unitless StructureMatcher RMSD between ML and DFT relaxed structures to relaxed_structure_matching_rmsd_task.

question_task_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of task {item}? Return only one existing class local name: BenchmarkTask, RegressionTask, ClassificationTask, or Task.

question_task_dataset.question: Which dataset does task {item} use? Return the dataset name or null.

question_fold_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of fold {item}? Return only Fold.

question_fold_index.question: What index is reported for fold {item}? Return an integer or null.

question_fold_train_split.question: Which training dataset split is associated with fold {item}? Return the split name or null.

question_fold_validation_split.question: Which validation dataset split is associated with fold {item}? Return the split name or null.

question_fold_test_split.question: Which test dataset split is associated with fold {item}? Return the split name or null.

question_fold_metric_results.question: Which metric results are produced for fold {item}? Return only a JSON array of metric result identifiers.

question_metric_result_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of metric result {item}? Return only MetricResult.

question_metric_result_metric_type.question: What metric type does metric result {item} measure? Return the exact Matbench Discovery metric name from YAML when available, such as F1, DAF, Precision, Recall, Accuracy, TPR, FPR, TNR, FNR, TP, FP, TN, FN, MAE, RMSE, R2, missing_preds, kappa_SRME, kappa_SRE, rmsd, n_sym_ops_mae, symmetry_decrease, symmetry_match, symmetry_increase, n_structures. Return null only if not specified.

question_metric_result_value.question: What numeric value is reported for metric result {item}? Return a float or null. Do not include units or uncertainty text in this value.

question_metric_result_unit.question: What unit is reported for metric result {item}, such as eV/atom, meV/atom, eV/Angstrom, GPa, percent, or dimensionless? Return a short unit string or null.

question_metric_result_task.question: Which task is this metric result for? Return the task name or null.

question_metric_result_dataset.question: Which dataset or split is this metric result measured on? Return the dataset or split name or null.

question_metric_type_type.question: What is the exact ontology class of metric type {item}? Return only MetricType.
